title: Cross-Vehicle Transferability of Lateral Velocity Estimation on Production Vehicles through Input Selection and Data Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24747v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lateral velocity is safety-critical for vehicle-dynamics control but cannot be measured with production sensors. Model-based estimators such as Kalman filters are established, whereas data-driven estimators are more accurate within the training regime but suspected to lose accuracy beyond it. Their transfer to a structurally different vehicle has rarely been tested. We record real-world test drives of three series-production vehicles, train a neural-network estimator on production CAN signals of a compact car, and evaluate it zero-shot on an SUV and a van against a GNSS-aided inertial reference. On the unseen vehicles, the network's error exceeds that on the training vehicle by an order of magnitude, a gap not quantified on production vehicles before. translated_title: 基于输入选择与数据增强的量产车辆横向速度估计跨车辆迁移性研究
translated_abstract: 横向速度对车辆动力学控制具有安全关键意义，但无法通过量产传感器直接测量。基于模型的估计器（如卡尔曼滤波器）已得到成熟应用，而数据驱动的估计器在训练范围内精度更高，但据推测在超出训练范围后会损失精度；将其迁移到结构不同的车辆上鲜有测试。我们记录了三辆量产车的真实道路测试驾驶数据，在一辆紧凑型轿车的量产CAN信号上训练神经网络估计器，并以GNSS辅助惯性参考为基准，在一辆SUV和一辆厢式车上进行零样本评估。在未见过的车辆上，网络的误差比在训练车辆上高出一个数量级，这一差距此前从未在量产车辆上被量化。对来自十个量产CAN信号的输入集进行系统比较，确定了一个迁移最稳健的五信号集。为缩小这一差距，我们引入了三种基于物理的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次在量产车辆上量化了神经网络横向速度估计器跨车辆零样本迁移时误差扩大一个数量级的精度差距，并通过系统比较CAN信号输入确定了迁移最稳健的五信号集，同时结合物理动机的数据增强方法来缩小这一差距。
en_tdlr: This work is the first to quantify, on production vehicles, the order-of-magnitude accuracy degradation of a neural-network lateral velocity estimator when transferred zero-shot to structurally different vehicles, and it identifies a robustly transferable five-signal CAN input set while using physically motivated data augmentation to narrow the gap.
